extra_quotes: Here, we combine circular-dichroic time-resolved extreme-ultraviolet momentum microscopy 10 with ab initio theory to investigate graphene driven by circularly polarized light.
The laser source was a high-repetition-rate Yb fiber laser (166 kHz, 1030 nm, 135 fs, 50 W; Amplitude Laser Group).

The ninth harmonic of the 515 nm driving field, corresponding to a photon energy of 21.6 eV , was selected using reflections from Sc/SiC multilayer XUV mirrors (NTTAT) in combination with a 200 nm-thick Sn filter (Luxel).
